label.zh: 仪式随机显现两种征兆之一
label.en: The rite reveals one of two signs

note.zh: 10天后enclave.4100以5:5随机开启“轨迹的征兆”或“来访者的征兆”；20年内出现过的征兆权重×0.2（overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7585-7625）。
note.en: 10 days later enclave.4100 starts Sign of the Locus or Sign of the Visitor at 5:5; a sign seen in the last 20 years has its weight x0.2 (overlord_enclaves_events.txt:7585-7625).

label.zh: 局势完成时的两种收尾
label.en: Two closings when the sign completes

note.zh: 若期间发生过一则预言（divination_occurring）则为“征兆消退”，否则为“不透明的帷幕”并补偿1000能量（01_overlord_situations.txt:87-100, 197-210）。
note.en: 'The Sign Fades' if a prophecy took place (divination_occurring), otherwise 'Opaque Veil' with 1000 energy (01_overlord_situations.txt:87-100, 197-210).
The foretold change has happened; the situation ends.

enclave.416.evidence: 01_overlord_situations.txt:87-95 on_progress_complete with divination_occurring -> enclave.416 (destroys the situation)

note.zh: 整个征兆期间没有预言发生，城邦以能量补偿。
note.en: No prophecy occurred during the sign; the enclave pays energy instead.

notes.zh: 审阅注：每月按10（无事）:1:1…抽取九则预言之一；每则预言的隐藏前置会设置divination_occurring，因此一次征兆最多应验一则。进度达90%仍无预言时，每月强制从同一组九则中抽一（enclave.5556，00_on_actions.txt:4946-4958）。
notes.en: Review note: each month the sign draws 10 (nothing) : 1 : 1 ... among nine prophecies; each prophecy's hidden gate sets divination_occurring, so a sign fulfils at most one. At 90% progress without a prophecy, one of the same nine is forced each month (enclave.5556, 00_on_actions.txt:4946-4958).

notes.zh: 审阅注：每月按10（无事）:1:1…抽取九则预言之一，最多应验一则；进度达90%仍无预言时强制抽取（enclave.5555，00_on_actions.txt:4932-4944）。其中“裂解的云群”“烦人的使节”“门扉”是借用其他故事的事件，以跨故事链接表示。
notes.en: Review note: each month draws 10 (nothing) : 1 : 1 ... among nine prophecies; at most one is fulfilled; at 90% progress one is forced (enclave.5555, 00_on_actions.txt:4932-4944). 'Dismembered Cloud', 'A Most Irritating Envoy' and 'The Doorway' reuse other stories' events and are shown as cross-story links.
